## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] `pnpm format` run (or `pnpm format:check` is clean)
- [ ] Touched `packages/ui`? Ran `pnpm registry` so `registry.json` is current
- [ ] Touched `packages/ui`? Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) — dependency
      and component changes ship to consumers via the registry
- [ ] New dependency? Pinned exact (no `^`/`~`) per `.npmrc`
